notes: needs ruling: «فقلت لأبي: ما قال؟ قال: قال: كلهم من قريش» : the narrator's father answers and gives the Prophet's word; the text does not say whether he transmits it as a link, so he is not added (rule 6)
«ومن حديث معمر بن سليمان» is read as the source of the report, so Mamar is the first link
